summary: A church visitor to a homebound member shares family news and church news and does most of the talking.
realLife: A deacon ministry guide says visits can be one-sided when the person has trouble speaking, so visitors bring news of family, weather and church, and respect those who don't want visits.
sources: Baptist News Global, Deacon ministry to the homebound: https://baptistnews.com/article/leadershiplinkdeaconministrytothehomebound/
